_comment: Data-space DMD (arXiv 2610.12102) of MOSS-Image-SFT, 50-step CFG 3 -> 8 NFE. Generator = frozen base + LoRA pinned at t=1: x0 <- z - v(z + Q x0, c_r), x0 starts at 0. Step r rides on the model's own time pathway (time(1) + zero-init time-MLP copy at the 8-step shift-5 timestep c_r; folded into the modulation biases at export), x0 enters through a zero-init 128x128 latent mix: the student is a stock MOSS transformer + LoRA. Real = base CFG 3 vs empty negative skipping block 22 (the release default), fake = 'fake' LoRA + zero-init per-step time table. Captions: trainer_samples_v3 scene_graph, compact JSON (MOSS's prompt form; see runs/moss-prompt-probe). Hyperparameters from krea2 turbo-kroma data-space v1.
